name: review-and-track-findings
description: Review code changes and track actionable findings through discussion, repair, and verification in a living repository document.

interface.shortDescription: Review changes and track findings to resolution
interface.longDescription: Review staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, then maintain stable finding IDs, evidence, priorities, decisions, fixes, and verification in code_review_issues.md. Explain findings or fix them when requested, and retain the document until explicit closure.
defaultPrompt: Use Review and Track Findings to review my current changes and record actionable findings in code_review_issues.md.
Use Review and Track Findings to explain CR-002 and recommend whether to fix it.
